reason: Project lens: src/sky_main.6502 is neither GENERATED nor PROTECTED (grind_config); not raster-timed (sky mode's draw in the render). No data, table, zero page or workspace moves: same reads (sky_rl/rh/rn/rt/ry in bank 4 render_bss, with the same paging as before since sky_row runs in main RAM &30xx and only its read order changes) and same writes (s_ptr+1, sky_n, sky_skip zp, Y). sky_rn is 1..8 on every entry (sky_geom: bottom row sky_L+1 with sky_L = A AND 7; others 8 or the remainder of sky_H-(L+1) after subtracting 8 while >= 9, which is >= 1 since H >= 23), so (n-1) EOR 7 = 8-n, n=8 -> 0 (Z set as before). DEC A is a 65SC12 opcode already used in the sky code (INC A in sky_hazel). Exit C/V differ but callers (sky_draw part: ASL ASL; whole: next_row CPX; sky_zero/sky_check: BNE then LDX/SEC, ORA...) never read them. CLC hoist: C=0 at each .row entry (first from the new CLC, later from CPX sky_nq with X < sky_nq after BEQ done not taken; nothing between .row and ADC sky_j8 touches C). Room: sky_row 27 -> 23 bytes, SKIP 4 restores the following addresses (.cell, .next_row, sky_zero, sky_img0 unchanged); sky_draw's CLC is moved not added; net 0, region below &3400, no new RAM. Paths the proofs never reach: sky_row only runs in play in sky mode (no front end, define controls, game over or completion use). Saves 5 cycles a sky_row call (EOR/SEC/ADC + LDA zp = 9 vs DEC A + EOR = 4) plus 2 per row after the first in sky_draw.
